content.text:
# Homepage implementation audit

**Scope:** Live route `src/app/(marketing)/page.tsx` → `getHomepage()` → `HomepageSections` / `HomepageSectionRenderer`. Config source: `content/config/homepage.json`. No files modified.

---

## 1. Section order (`content/config/homepage.json`)

All **12** sections are `enabled: true`. Order matches the JSON array.

| # | id | type | enabled | Key data summary |
|---|-----|------|---------|------------------|
| 1 | `hero` | `hero` | true | Eyebrow “Amazon Ads Verified Partner”; H1 full-service growth; dual CTAs (`#hero-lead-form`, `/case-studies/`); partner badge + trust line; `visual.type: leadForm` with 7 fields + consent; **`deferredVisual.type: browserMockup`** (not rendered) |
| 2 | `trust-bar` | `trustBar` | true | Partner badge + “$112M+ revenue managed”; 3 logos (eLEEVATE, Amazon Verified Partner, SSP) |
| 3 | `stats` | `stats` | true | 4 stats: $112M+, 95%, 20+, 2018 |
| 4 | `services` | `services` | true | 6 service cards (title, 1-line description, href, lucide icon name) |
| 5 | `seller-segments` | `sellerSegments` | true | 3 segments: new / scaling / multi-ASIN (title + short description only) |
| 6 | `case-studies` | `caseStudies` | true | 3 results (metric, brand, category, service, description, href) + “View all” CTA |
| 7 | `process` | `process` | true | 4 steps: Audit → Strategy → Execute → Report |
| 8 | `comparison` | `comparison` | true | Agency vs DIY table, 6 feature rows |
| 9 | `testimonials` | `testimonials` | true | 5 named quotes; `minimumCountNote` flags need for a 6th (config only) |
| 10 | `blog-preview` | `blogPreview` | true | 3 posts (slug, title, date, excerpt, href) + blog CTA |
| 11 | `faq` | `faq` | true | 10 Q&As (services, differentiation, audit, pricing, new sellers, marketplaces, metrics, retention, timeline, get started) |
| 12 | `final-cta` | `cta` | true | Free audit heading; CTA to `/free-audit-2/`; phone + email |

**SEO block** (same file): meta title/description, canonical `/`, index+follow.

**Schema note:** `homepage.schema.ts` also allows `contactTeaser`; it is **not** in the current sections array.

---

## 2. React mapping

**Entry:** `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\app\(marketing)\page.tsx`  
loads homepage via repository, emits JSON-LD (`buildHomepageJsonLd`), renders `<HomepageSections sections={...} />`.

**Switch:** `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\sections\homepage-section-renderer.tsx`

| type | Component | File |
|------|-----------|------|
| `hero` | `HeroSection` | `src/components/sections/hero-section.tsx` |
| `trustBar` | `TrustBarSection` | `trust-bar-section.tsx` (+ `trust-logo.tsx`) |
| `stats` | `StatsSection` | `stats-section.tsx` |
| `services` | `ServicesSection` | `services-section.tsx` (+ `section-icon.tsx`) |
| `sellerSegments` | `SellerSegmentsSection` | `seller-segments-section.tsx` |
| `caseStudies` | `CaseStudiesSection` | `case-studies-section.tsx` |
| `process` | `ProcessSection` | `process-section.tsx` |
| `comparison` | `ComparisonSection` | `comparison-section.tsx` |
| `testimonials` | `TestimonialsSection` | `testimonials-section.tsx` |
| `blogPreview` | `BlogPreviewSection` | `blog-preview-section.tsx` |
| `faq` | `FaqSection` | `faq-section.tsx` (+ client `faq-accordion.tsx`) |
| `cta` | `CtaSection` | `cta-section.tsx` |
| `contactTeaser` | **returns `null`** | renderer only |
| unknown / disabled | `null` | |

**Shared chrome:** `section-shell.tsx`, `section-heading.tsx`, `section-data.ts`.

**Hero form wiring:** `ConfigurableForm` + `submitAuditForm` from `src/app/(marketing)/free-audit-2/actions`.

**Preview path:** `homepage-sections-preview.tsx` embeds the same renderer on the design-system page.

---

## 3. Quality notes (polished vs thin)

### Relatively polished
- **Hero conversion path:** Split layout, accent primary CTA + text secondary, partner badge image with external directory link, compact 2-column lead form, honeypot + consent + privacy link (`/privacy-policy-2/`), Server Action submit. Documented in `docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md` (2026-09-03).
- **FAQ:** 10 substantive answers; accordion UX; FAQPage JSON-LD in `homepage-json-ld.ts`.
- **Comparison:** Real table on `md+`, stacked cards on mobile.
- **Case studies / testimonials:** Named brands/people and outcome-oriented copy (not lorem).
- **SEO metadata:** Page `generateMetadata` from config SEO.
- **Section system:** Consistent `SectionShell` tones (`default` / `muted` / `primary` CTA).

### Thin / placeholder-adjacent
- **Services:** One-line descriptions only; Lucide icons only (no photography, no outcome metrics per service).
- **Seller segments:** Title + one sentence; no CTAs, icons, or segment-specific links.
- **Stats / process:** Label-value / numbered cards; no illustration, animation, or connectors.
- **Case studies:** Text metric cards only — **no images, logos, charts, or before/after**.
- **Blog preview:** Title/date/excerpt links only — **no featured images**.
- **Testimonials:** Quote cards only — **no avatars, logos, star ratings, or carousel**.
- **Trust bar:** Overlaps hero badge (Amazon partner appears in badge + logos list).
- **Imagery overall:** Homepage is almost entirely typography + borders + lucide; no product/atmosphere photography.
- **Interactivity:** FAQ accordion + form only. **No motion** under `src/components/sections/` (no framer/animate usage).
- **`minimumCountNote`:** Present in JSON; **never read** by `TestimonialsSection`.

---

## 4. Assets related to homepage

### Present under `public/images/` (verified on disk)

| Path | Homepage use |
|------|----------------|
| `public/images/amazon-verified-partner.png` | Hero `partnerBadge`, trust-bar badge + logos |
| `public/images/trust/eleevate-logistics.png` | Trust bar |
| `public/images/trust/ssp-partner.png` | Trust bar |
| `public/images/logo.png` / `logo-dark.png` | Site chrome / JSON-LD org logo (not section-specific) |
| `public/images/ai/*.svg` | AI marks — **not referenced by homepage sections** |

### `assets/`
- `assets/source/ecom-gliders-logo.png` (source)
- AI SVGs under `assets/source/ai/` and `assets/icons/ai/`
- `assets/approved/` empty (`.gitkeep` only)
- No homepage case-study, client, or hero photography in approved assets

### Config-referenced but not a rendered homepage image
- Browser mockup is **CSS/SVG UI** via `content/config/browser-mockup.json` + `src/components/browser-mockup/*` — used on design-system preview, **not** on `/` after hero change.

---

## 5. Gaps vs a conversion-focused Amazon agency landing page

Factual gaps relative to typical mid-market agency LPs (and this repo’s own competitor notes in `docs/research/HERO-COMPETITOR-UI-AUDIT-2026-09-03.md` / SEO competitive research):

| Expectation | Current state |
|-------------|----------------|
| Strong proof visual (metrics on UI, people, listing creative) | Form-only hero; mockup deferred and unused on homepage |
| Client / brand logo wall | 3 partner badges only; no seller brand logos |
| Case study cards with visuals | Text-only metrics |
| Social proof density | 5 quotes; config says 6th still required |
| Service depth that sells | Link-out cards, shallow copy |
| Mid-page / sticky conversion | Hero form + bottom CTA only; middle sections are mostly informational |
| Atmosphere / brand imagery | Flat token backgrounds (`bg-surface` / `bg-primary`); no photography |
| Motion / hierarchy | Static cards |
| Objection handling beyond FAQ | Comparison table helps; no pricing bands, guarantees, or “who we don’t work with” |
| Segment → CTA paths | Segments have no links into audits/services |

**Note:** Research doc previously argued *against* form-in-hero for 30+ buyers; implementation **chose form-in-hero** (AMZ Dudes–style) on 2026-09-03 — intentional conversion tradeoff, still light on visual proof.

---

## 6. Deferred / incomplete items

| Item | Evidence |
|------|----------|
| **`deferredVisual` / `browserMockup`** | In `homepage.json` hero data with note to place later; `HeroSection` only renders when `visual.type === "leadForm"`. **No `deferredVisual` read in `src/`.** Component still exists and is shown on design-system page. |
| **`contactTeaser`** | In `homepageSectionTypeSchema`; renderer returns `null`; not in homepage sections. |
| **Sixth testimonial** | `minimumCountNote` in JSON; not enforced or displayed in UI. |
| **Interactive mockup tabs / auto-rotate** | Chat summaries / Browser-Mockup-Spec: interactive behavior deferred; static preview mode in design system. |
| **Content-audit approvals** | `CONTENT-AUDIT-LOG.md`: hero form + CTA href changes marked **pending** approval. |
| **Homepage imagery migration** | No case-study/blog/hero photos in `public/`; blog featured-image migration noted elsewhere as deferred. |
| **Duplicate trust signals** | Amazon badge repeated hero + trust bar logos list (implementation redundancy, not a TODO flag). |

---

## Wiring summary (facts)

```
homepage.json (12 enabled)
  → JsonFileContentRepository.getHomepage()
  → page.tsx → HomepageSections
  → HomepageSectionRenderer switch
  → section components under src/components/sections/
```

**STATUS:** Homepage route is assembled and section-complete in config.  
**VERIFIED (from code/fs):** Section order, component map, form wiring, asset file presence, unused `deferredVisual`, null `contactTeaser`.  
**REMAINING for conversion polish:** Visual proof (mockup/metrics or photography), deeper mid-funnel CTAs, case/blog imagery, sixth testimonial, optional re-placement of BrowserMockup.
